title: The Tank II: Deeper
transcript:
The last count. Eight.
They go past the steps, down where the water turns cold and brown.
An iron grate in the tank wall, where the water is let out to the fields.

Raman kicks off it. His foot goes through the bars.
He pulls. It doesn't come back.

Bubbles. Raman's eyes, wide and strangely calm for one second. Then not.
A small hand finds Parth's wrist. Holds on.

The memory stops there, like a tape someone has paused.
Something is holding it under.
